summary:
When astronauts travel to the Moon or Mars, round-trip communication delays with Earth can reach up to 44 minutes. Crews cannot wait on flight surgeons for routine checkups or sudden medical emergencies, yet most astronauts are not physicians.

ASTRA-MED is an interactive, onboard health monitoring and triage web application built for deep-space crews. Astronauts can switch between LEO/ISS, Lunar, and Mars mission modes, click directly on a human body map to inspect five major physiological systems, and view color-coded vitals with plain-language instructions on how and why to take each measurement in microgravity. Grounded in NASA research baselines, ASTRA-MED turns raw health readings into immediate, step-by-step countermeasures and flight-surgeon telemetry packets.
details:
### Why We Built ASTRA-MED

Long-duration missions expose astronauts to NASA's Five Hazards of Human Spaceflight: space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity fields, and hostile closed environments. Because deep-space signal delays make real-time consultations impossible, astronauts need a fast, self-guided medical console that explains what is happening in their bodies and what to do next.

### How It Works

- **Mission Environment & Latency Switcher:** Crew members switch between LEO/ISS (~0.5 s latency, microgravity), Lunar (~2.6 s round-trip latency, 0.16g), and Mars (4–22 min one-way latency, 0g/0.38g) modes so triage workflows reflect real communication constraints.

- **Interactive Diagnostic Body Map:** Clicking any of the five body regions—Neurological, Cardiovascular, Immune/Metabolic, Musculoskeletal, or Radiation/Environment—opens live vital signs, explains how spaceflight affects that system, and displays immediate countermeasure steps.

- **Color-Coded Triage & Zero-G Measurement Guides:** Every indicator uses clear Green (Nominal), Amber (Watch), or Red (Critical) status badges. Built-in "How & Why to Measure in Zero-G" panels walk non-physician astronauts through taking accurate readings in space and understanding why each exam matters.

- **Anomaly Simulation & Flight Surgeon Telemetry Packets:** Built-in scenario presets (such as a Mars Solar Particle Event radiation spike) trigger immediate crew stabilization alerts—such as EVA abort and storm-shelter protocols—while packaging a structured telemetry report for Earth flight surgeons.

- **Mission Health Readiness & Daily Routine:** A live 0–100 readiness score, check-in streak badge, and interactive daily checklist (morning vitals, 2-hour ARED resistive exercise, sleep quality log, and circadian light reset) encourage consistent preventive care.

### Impact Beyond Space

The same self-triage workflow designed for Mars transit vehicles translates directly to remote environments on Earth—including polar research stations, submarines, and rural telemedicine clinics—where specialist doctors are not immediately available.

### Tools & Source Code

- **Built With:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and interactive SVG anatomical graphics

- **Live App:** https://joffinranjith.github.io/Astra-Med/

- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/joffinranjith/Astra-Med
